title: The Descent of the Call Through the Members of the Soul
description: When the Call descends to rouse the Living Soul, it passes through the five faculties down to the soul defiled in the Enemy and draws her back inward into the icon of her Father. The First Man is the head joining all members, set under the Father (clothed in the Virgin of Light) and over the Pillar of Glory. The dispersed soul is not a heap of fragments but a single organism, and its survival rests entirely upon its connection to its head.
